effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon get linked, by suspending this Tamer, 1 of your Digimon with the [Appmon] trait gains <Vortex> (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.) and +3000 DP for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may app fuse into a Digimon card in the hand.
